name: Delete Commerce Order Periodically
description: Bulk-deletes old Commerce orders (and their payments) by date, on demand via a batch or automatically on cron via a queue worker.
project_description: Delete Commerce Order Periodically (project machine name delete_commerce_order, human title "Commerce Order Bulk Delete") lets a store administrator purge old Commerce orders together with their commerce_payment records. An admin form at /admin/commerce/order-deletion either runs an on-demand Batch API deletion of all orders created before a chosen date, or saves a periodic-cron configuration that, on each cron run, queries orders older than a preset interval and enqueues them for a queue worker to delete. It requires Commerce and Commerce Order and is gated by the 'administer commerce_order' permission. Deletion is irreversible, so the module strongly advises taking a database backup first. Developed by Prabu (PrabuEla), sponsored by Specbee.
